Coefficient methods for the hurdle model

Source: R/methods-extra.R
hurdle-methods.Rd

coef(), vcov(), confint(), nobs() and summary() for hurdle fits (panhurdle()). The coefficients of the zero part (conditional logit of 1(y > 0)) and of the count part (zero-truncated count model on the positive observations) are named "zero:..." and "count:...". The two parts are estimated from separate factors of the hurdle likelihood, so vcov() is block diagonal. No logLik() method is provided: the zero part maximises a conditional likelihood and the count part an unconditional likelihood with individual intercepts, so their sum is not the log-likelihood of one model.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'panglm_hurdle'
coef(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'panglm_hurdle'
vcov(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'panglm_hurdle'
nobs(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'panglm_hurdle'
confint(object, parm, level = 0.95, ...)

# S3 method for class 'panglm_hurdle'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'summary.panglm_hurdle'
print(x, digits = max(3, getOption("digits") - 3), ...)

Arguments

object

a "panglm_hurdle" fit

...

unused

parm

names or positions of the coefficients; all by default

level

confidence level

x

a "summary.panglm_hurdle" object

digits

significant digits to print

Value

coef(): a named vector; vcov(): a matrix; confint(): a two-column matrix; nobs(): the number of observations; summary(): an object of class "summary.panglm_hurdle" with one coefficient table per part (zero, count: estimate, standard error, z value and p-value, from the inverse Hessian of each part) and the fit information.

See also

Other panhurdle methods: plot.panglm_hurdle()

Examples

data(copd)
fit <- panhurdle(exacerbations ~ crp, data = copd, index = c("id", "visit"))
#> 26 group(s) with no within-group outcome variation dropped (all-0 or all-1) -- they carry no information for the conditional likelihood.
coef(fit)
#>   zero:crp  count:crp 
#> 0.10889286 0.04246066 
confint(fit)
#>                 2.5 %     97.5 %
#> zero:crp  -0.05129363 0.26907935
#> count:crp -0.00624235 0.09116367
summary(fit)
#> 
#> Formula: exacerbations ~ crp
#> 
#> Estimator: fixed-effects hurdle model (conditional logit and zero-truncated Poisson)
#> N = 300  positive = 238  vcov: model-based (inverse Hessian)
#> 
#> Zero part, 1(y > 0), conditional logit (groups used = 34):
#>     Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)
#> crp  0.10889    0.08173   1.332    0.183
#> 
#> Count part, y | y > 0, zero-truncated Poisson (groups used = 59):
#>     Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)  
#> crp  0.04246    0.02485   1.709   0.0875 .
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
#>
